_readme: Edit this file, then re-run setup.sh (or setup.ps1). The wiring is safe to repeat: anything that already exists is skipped.
public_indexers: indexers that need no account. 'definition' is the indexer's name in Prowlarr (case, spaces and dots do not matter). Set flaresolverr to true for indexers behind Cloudflare.

private_indexers: PUT YOUR PRIVATE TRACKER LOGINS HERE. Copy the example below into the empty list, change the definition name, and fill in the fields that tracker needs (see 'fields' for examples: username, password, apikey, cookie, passkey). Field names must match what Prowlarr shows for that tracker.
Only add indexers for content you have the rights to download.
